name: bible
title: Bible
description: Search Bible passages by reference, in 233 versions including the Russian Synodal.
author: black

commands.name: bibleSearch
commands.title: Bible Search
commands.description: Search for Bible passages by reference.

preferences.name: separatePassages
preferences.label: Show passages as separate list items
preferences.description: Display each passage as its own list item in the search results. Otherwise passages will be combined into one item.
preferences.title: Show passages as separate list items
Formatting Options
preferences.name: includeVerseNumbers
preferences.label: Include verse numbers
preferences.description: Include individual verse numbers in the results.

preferences.name: includeCopyright
preferences.label: Show copyright
preferences.description: Add copyright information to the shown results. Always excluded from copied text.
preferences.title: Show copyright

preferences.name: includeReferences
preferences.label: Include references
preferences.description: Add passage references to the results.
preferences.title: Include references

preferences.name: oneVersePerLine
preferences.label: Show one verse per line
preferences.description: Display each verse on a separate line. Might separate verses into multiple lines, for ex. see Psalm 1 (ESV)
preferences.title: Show one verse per line
